name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
department: All India Council for Technical Education
target_group: Eligible girl students admitted to approved technical education programmes
eligibility: Eligibility depends on current AICTE Pragati guidelines, approved institution/programme and family-income conditions.
benefits: Financial scholarship support for eligible girl students pursuing technical education.
application_process: Apply through the official National Scholarship Portal/AICTE process during the notified period.
source: AICTE / Ministry of Education, Government of India
